title: Cyanobacteria-derived biochar supported ZIF-8-derived ZnS–NC for superior peroxymonosulfate activation to remove 4-chlorophenol from wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2407-2420
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00004A, Paper
Ronghan Wang, Qingkai Shi, Wenjun Wang, Guangfu Wang, Yang Liu, Jun Wang, Chengyun Zhou, Min Cheng, Weiping Xiong, Dongbo Wang
Cyanobacteria-derived biochar supported ZIF-8-derived ZnS–NC was used for efficient activation of PMS to remove 4-CP, which synergistically treated solid waste and wastewater.
